court: Appellate Division of the Supreme Court of the State of New York

issues.label: Which convictions govern SORA jurisdiction/venue
issues.why: The court must decide whether Sullivan County offenses alone properly frame the risk assessment given multi-county convictions.

issues.label: Correct scoring of presumptive RAI points
issues.why: The court must review whether the 100-point assessment placing defendant at level two was correctly calculated under the guidelines.

issues.label: Individual risk factor point challenges
issues.why: Defendant may contest specific factors' scoring, which the court must evaluate for each disputed category.

issues.label: Standard/burden for upward departure
issues.why: The court must apply the correct legal standard and clear-and-convincing evidence burden for departures.

issues.label: Existence of aggravating factor not captured by RAI
issues.why: An upward departure requires an identified aggravating factor the RAI does not adequately account for.

issues.label: Second underage victim as valid departure basis
issues.why: The court must determine whether the uncounted second victim constitutes a proper aggravating circumstance.

issues.label: Double-counting concern in departure rationale
issues.why: The court must ensure the departure factor was not already reflected in the presumptive score.

issues.label: Consideration of Queens County convictions
issues.why: The court must decide whether crimes from separate informations can support departure though not scored.

issues.label: Overlapping victim across counties
issues.why: Because one victim appears in both actions, the court must avoid mischaracterizing victim count.

issues.label: Discretion to grant or deny departure
issues.why: Even if grounds exist, the court retains discretion whether departure is warranted by the totality.

issues.label: Evidentiary support for departure findings
issues.why: The court must ensure reliable record evidence supports the aggravating facts relied upon.

issues.label: Mitigating factors weighed against departure
issues.why: The court must consider any mitigating circumstances defendant raises before departing upward.

issues.label: Adequacy of findings of fact
issues.why: SORA requires the court to set forth findings and conclusions supporting its determination.

issues.label: Special designations (predicate/predator/etc.)
issues.why: The court noted 'no further designation,' so it must consider whether any statutory designation applies.

issues.label: Notice and due process at hearing
issues.why: The court must ensure defendant received proper notice of the grounds for departure.
